# Xdatrys

> Xdatrys is an international travel and smartphone photography company that shows travelers where to go, where to stand and how to frame the shot, so great photos need no editing.

## Pocket Lens newsletter
- [All issues](https://xdatrys.com/issues/): every issue of the daily smartphone travel photography newsletter
- [Subscribe](https://xdatrys.com/subscribe/): the free newsletter, five issues a week
- [RSS feed](https://xdatrys.com/feed.xml): the newest issues

## Free shot maps
- [All shot maps](https://xdatrys.com/maps/): where to stand to photograph each place with a phone
- [Bergen, Norway: Best Photo Spot and Where to Stand](https://xdatrys.com/maps/bergen/): Where to stand by the harbour in Bergen, Norway, to feature the rain and bring bright color into the frame. Free shot map of Bergen, Norway from Xdatrys.
- [Bora Bora, French Polynesia: Best Photo Spot and Where to Stand](https://xdatrys.com/maps/bora-bora/): Where to stand on Motu Tapu in Bora Bora for the sunset crowd shot, and a taste of the full Pocket Scout guide.
- [Bulguksa, Gyeongju: Best Photo Spot and Where to Stand](https://xdatrys.com/maps/bulguksa/): Three places to stand at Bulguksa Temple in Gyeongju, from the entrance gate to the terrace under the trees. Free shot map of Bulguksa, Gyeongju from Xdatrys.
- [Caernarfon Castle, United Kingdom: Best Photo Spot and Where to Stand](https://xdatrys.com/maps/caernarfon-castle/): Where to stand by the quay in Caernarfon, Wales, to photograph the castle. Free shot map of Caernarfon Castle, United Kingdom from Xdatrys.
- [Cesky Krumlov, Czechia: Best Photo Spot and Where to Stand](https://xdatrys.com/maps/cesky-krumlov/): Where to stand in Cesky Krumlov, Czechia, where one step sideways changes the photo. Free shot map of Cesky Krumlov, Czechia from Xdatrys.
- [Cologne Cathedral, Germany: Best Photo Spot and Where to Stand](https://xdatrys.com/maps/cologne-cathedral/): Where to stand by Domkloster in Cologne to photograph the cathedral from an angle most tourists miss. Free shot map of Cologne Cathedral, Germany from Xdatrys.
- [Columbus Circle, New York: Best Photo Spot and Where to Stand](https://xdatrys.com/maps/columbus-circle/): Where to stand at Columbus Circle in New York, and the one setting that freezes a moving cyclist. Free shot map of Columbus Circle, New York from Xdatrys.
- [Daigo-ji Temple, Kyoto: Best Photo Spot and Where to Stand](https://xdatrys.com/maps/daigoji-temple/): Where to stand at Daigo-ji Temple in Kyoto, Japan, for the photo spots most visitors almost miss. Free shot map of Daigo-ji Temple, Kyoto from Xdatrys.
- [Dresden, Germany: Best Photo Spot and Where to Stand](https://xdatrys.com/maps/dresden/): Three places to stand for the Frauenkirche, and a taste of the full Pocket Scout guide. Free shot map of Dresden, Germany from Xdatrys.

- [Meriken Park, Kobe, Japan: Best Photo Spot and Where to Stand](https://xdatrys.com/maps/kobe-meriken-park/): Where to stand at the Meriken Park fountains in Kobe, Japan, with the Kobe Port Tower, for a long exposure photo.
